name: Koiwai Flora
source: Flora Koiwai is Sumomo and Masaharu's Classmate at Hoshigaoka School.  She is Fukamichi Nobuko's best friend. Her family owns a restaurant named "Lime Light". Flora herself works there. She's good at cooking, and can be counted on anytime when she is needed, especially when there's heart-related manners.
